items.title: Trump scraps threat of 20% fee on Hormuz cargo as US resumes blockade of Iran ports
items.description: Trump drops a 24-hour-old vow to charge cargo ships for using the Strait as the US continues its battle to break Iran's hold on the waterway.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz 'faultline' exposes weakness of the US-Iran deal
items.description: Control of the waterway has become a key point of contention between the US and Iran, as a ceasefire deal falters.

items.title: Israeli strike on police post in north Gaza kills seven, officials say
items.description: A senior officer in the Hamas-run police force was among those killed in the strike, which Israel's military says targeted "terrorists".

items.title: Diamond giant De Beers halts work at flagship South African mine as demand plummets
items.description: Production will stop for two years at the mine which employs more than 4,000 people.

items.title: 'If we die, we die together': Wife of man nearly sucked out of Ryanair plane speaks of ordeal
items.description: Svetlana Grković told Serbian media that her husband is "seriously injured and in shock".

items.title: Trump pays writer E Jean Carroll $5m in damages over sexual abuse and defamation
items.description: The president had sought to delay the payment as he tried to persuade the Supreme Court to overturn the judgement.

items.title: Tyrannosaurus rex most expensive dinosaur ever sold
items.description: The dinosaur skeleton, which roamed the planet 67 million years ago, was sold by Sotheby's in New York.

items.title: Bangkok fire investigation finds locked doors and flammable decor as deaths climb to 30
items.description: Survivors and first responders reported locked doors and a lack of signage marking emergency exits.

items.title: Singapore court orders Bloomberg to pay $356,000 to ministers in defamation case
items.description: The ministers claimed the piece, which cited their luxury bungalow deals, had tarnished their reputation.

items.title: How US commerce secretary's Epstein links were uncovered by British whistleblower
items.description: Simon Andriesz made the discovery about Howard Lutnick in publicly released Epstein files.

items.title: Australian police reveal unseen photos 25 years after British backpacker murder
items.description: Police hope the images could jog memories that will help them find the body of Peter Falconio.

items.title: Hungary parliament votes to remove president from office
items.description: Tamás Sulyok was widely seen as a loyalist of former prime minister Viktor Orbán, who lost power in April after 16 years.
